proposal.expected_benefit: This will ensure that the audit and compliance controls are consistently applied, reducing the risk of contradictions and improving the overall security posture by making the enforcement process transparent and repeatable.
proposal.problem: The defense response lacks clarity on how audit-before-execution and compliance gates are enforced in practice, which could lead to contradictions or ambiguities.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a clear and documented enforcement framework for audit-before-execution and compliance gates, including specific steps for audit status verification, compliance decision validation, and integration with existing control mechanisms to ensure consistency and reduce ambiguity.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit and Compliance Enforcement Implementation
verification_tests: Review audit and compliance enforcement procedures for clarity and consistency
Validate that audit status verification and compliance decision validation are integrated into the control framework
Test the enforcement of audit-before-execution and compliance gates under simulated attack scenarios
